theme.description: Neon-club Dubai dark aesthetic. Confident, aspirational, premium, pixel-conscious.

pricing_hero_bg.description: Wide atmospheric abstract background for pricing hero section

pricing.layout: Marketing page bento grid and wide sections

test_mode_banner.style: bg-yellow-500/10 text-yellow-500 font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-center py-2 border-b border-yellow-500/20 w-full fixed top-0 z-50

hero_section.heading: text-5xl md:text-6xl+ font-black text-white text-center pt-32 pb-8
hero_section.currency_selector: pill-shaped toggle, glassmorphism, accenting active state with cyan (#00d9ff)

pricing_cards.premium_tier: glassmorphism, border-[#ff2d95]/50 neon_glow_pink, p-8 rounded-3xl relative overflow-hidden
pricing_cards.premium_badge: absolute top-0 right-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-[#ff2d95] to-[#00d9ff] text-white font-mono text-[10px] px-3 py-1 rounded-bl-xl
pricing_cards.cta_premium: w-full bg-[#ff2d95] text-white hover:bg-[#ff2d95]/90 py-4 rounded-xl font-bold uppercase tracking-wide transition-all neon_glow_pink data-testid='go-premium-cta'
pricing_cards.price_display: text-4xl font-black text-white, with 'billed annually' in font-mono text-xs text-gray-400

elements.card: glassmorphism max-w-md mx-auto p-12 text-center rounded-3xl border border-[#ff2d95]/30 neon_glow_pink
elements.heading: text-3xl font-black text-white mb-4
elements.loader: cyan pulsing indicator for session status

premium_user.badge: inline-flex items-center gap-1 bg-[#ffd700]/10 text-[#ffd700] border border-[#ffd700]/30 font-mono text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full

profile_premium_tile.style: glassmorphism border-[#00d9ff]/30 p-6 rounded-2xl flex justify-between items-center
profile_premium_tile.content: Show VIP status, renewal date, and 'Manage Billing' button (cyan bordered)

radio_player.vip_badge: Gold/cyan VIP badge next to username (use lucide Crown icon)
radio_player.skip_text: Replace standard skip counter with 'Unlimited skips' in text-[#00d9ff] font-mono text-xs for premium users

channel_switcher.free_user_premium_chip: opacity-70 grayscale hover:grayscale-0 transition-all cursor-pointer relative
channel_switcher.lock_icon: absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-white bg-black/50 p-2 rounded-full backdrop-blur-md

skip_limit_modal.heading: text-2xl font-black text-white mb-2
skip_limit_modal.cta: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#ff2d95] to-[#00d9ff] text-white w-full py-3 rounded-xl font-bold uppercase mt-6 hover:opacity-90 data-testid='modal-upgrade-nudge'

testing.requirements: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the /pricing page following the layout and dark neon colors provided.
Ensure CF-IPCountry header logic correctly maps currencies: AE->AED, IN->INR, US/CA/AU/GB->USD, fallback->USD. Allow ?currency= override.
Use standard HTML tags and Tailwind classes. Avoid Shadcn components for marketing layouts unless heavily customized to fit the neon aesthetic.
Apply the test mode banner 'Test mode · No real charges' globally on /pricing.
Integrate the generated media URLs for backgrounds and channel covers.
For the Radio Player, swap the skip counter logic to display 'Unlimited skips' for premium tier.
Ensure all buttons and links have proper data-testid attributes.
